entities.summary: Robert Charles Fick is an American former professional baseball first baseman. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Detroit Tigers, Atlanta Braves, Tampa Bay Devil Rays, San Diego Padres, and Washington Nationals. In 2002, he was named to the American League All-Star Team.
